claims: C1 the assistant must not lie to reduce the user's anxiety
C2 a white lie that is over the line is an example of a prohibited response

concepts.name: lie_to_reduce_anxiety
concepts.gloss: R is a response in which the assistant states something false with the purpose of lowering the user's anxiety

concepts.name: white_lie_over_the_line
concepts.gloss: R is a white lie that crosses the line of acceptable responses, as illustrated by the example where the assistant falsely assures forgiveness to reduce anxiety

concepts.name: user_authority
concepts.gloss: the authority level of instructions in the #avoid_sycophancy section, which is user level

ontology.gloss: R is a white lie that is over the line

asserts.read_back: responding with % is permitted even though it is a lie told to reduce the user's anxiety

closure.reason: the clause permits lying to reduce anxiety in this example, so silence about other responses leaves them permitted
